Secures utilization of GMP facilities in Spain/Argentina; manufacturing margins accrue to mAbxience.
Sandoz gets global rights excl. 3 countries
Global exclusivity (ex-AR/UY/PY) simplifies commercialization and signals commitment.
Targets a large reference market in hemophilia A; sizable revenue pool if approved/competitive.
Revenue impact uncertain near term; watch for milestones/royalties disclosure later.
